description: iss_48ea8171 (2026-09-20). Returns the stored model x effort table -- Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index score, real USD cost-per-task, the seed-or-run-derived relative_cost_multiplier, acceptance state, measured_at and the per-cell staleness window -- with each cell annotated is_fresh (measured inside its window at as_of) and servable (accepted; age never withholds a reading, per rul_becb4bed -- is_fresh is informational). By default only accepted cells are returned; include_unaccepted=true also returns pending_crosscheck, crosscheck_conflict and withdrawn cells so a reviewer can see what the catalog is waiting on. Optional runtime and model filters. This read is what the hand-maintained ticket-header JSON on prj_937a6ec1 is replaced by. The read walks the table in pages of 100 rows up to a ceiling of 1000 rows and never refuses for size: past the ceiling it returns the first 1000 rows in runtime, model, effort order and adds a warnings line naming the first row it did not consider. Each cell carries harness_unverified_since: non-null means the harness cannot confirm that model right now (on a withdrawn cell, the refresh withdrew it automatically); null on a withdrawn cell means a person withdrew it and a refresh never reverses that.
embedding_description: Looking up the stored table of which AI models at which reasoning-effort settings score how well and cost how much per task, and seeing which rows are verified and recent enough that automated work assignment is allowed to rely on them.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: cells (rows plus is_fresh, servable; each row includes harness_unverified_since), total_cells, servable_cells, as_of, and warnings when the read stopped at its ceiling.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Lead with servable_cells versus total_cells. When zero cells are servable, say the catalog is not yet usable by dispatch and name the acceptance states present rather than presenting scores as if they were live. When warnings is present, tell the operator its text: the answer is missing the rows from the named one on.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Pass a cell's capability_score scale (0-100 AA index) into select_dispatch_tier's required_score; do not hand-pick a cell from this read when the selector can be asked.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: One ordered query over model_capability_cell through the state interface; no writes.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: state_service_unavailable: the state service is not bound. A read never fails for size; a catalog past the ceiling is answered with a warnings line.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: If warnings names a truncated read, narrow with the runtime or model filter to see the missing rows, and withdraw or retire rows that no longer matter; the table keeps withdrawn history, so it only grows.
